JS1_Part1_Fab-Stackup.csv is a verbatim copy of the JS1 Jumpstart kit's part1-stackup/JS1_Part1_Fab-Stackup.csv in <py-components> (jumpstart-kits/js1-stackup-components/part1-stackup/). The self-tests grade the installed kit board against this copy, so the copy and the installed kit board update together.
